ker_case.d5_answer_where_was_the_money: TWO pockets, not one. Pocket 1 (the big one): announcement -> first strategic actions, Jun-26-2025 EUR171.9 -> Oct-20-2025 EUR319.6 = +86%, almost all of it BEFORE or within 0.4 quarters of the seat date — because Kering's kitchen-sink (3 warnings + Demna) PRE-dated the appointment, the appointment itself was the entry. Pocket 2: the proof-print, +16.9% on Jul-29-2026 (q3.5 in-seat), rewarding entries made in the Oct-2025->Jul-2026 doubt-relapse derate (EUR319->239, -25% dead-money). D5 as written ('2-6 quarters in-seat') captured only pocket 2 and missed pocket 1 entirely. REFINEMENT: run the D5 clock from KITCHEN-SINK COMPLETION, not seat date — entry = max(kitchen-sink done, leadership resolved); when the sink pre-dates the hire (KER, CMG), announcement day IS the entry.

verdict: The conditional base rate SUPPORTS a weaker, sharper version of the thesis. What is strongly supported: D1 (proven turnaround record) is the load-bearing discriminant — D1-fail cohort went 0/8 on positive 1y alpha (mean -30.5pp) while D1-pass went 6/10 (mean +19.5pp); and the full C1 pattern went 4/5 on 1y alpha (mean +33pp, median +26pp) with both misses being macro-crash windows (GFC, COVID) in which the leader still delivered operationally. D2 matters: the one clean D2-fail control (Darrell/VF: D1+D4 pass, franchise structurally broken) was the worst C1-adjacent outcome at -67pp. What is NOT supported: D4 as a hard screen-OUT — the two biggest in-window winners in the sample (Niccol/CMG +102pp 1y, Tan/Intel +141pp 2y) were CHEERED arrivals, and C2's 2y mean (+66pp) actually beats C1's (+14pp); D4's real content is entry TIMING and drawdown shape (cheered arrivals defer the kitchen-sink and dead-money 3.5-6 quarters; doubted arrivals resolve in 0-1.5) and it should be demoted from screen to entry-modifier, measured at the intended ENTRY date (KER: short-interest peak at the September seat, after the announcement pop round-tripped). KER itself scores D1-D6 pass retrospectively, but its money was made in a pocket the current D5 wording misses: +86% from announcement-dip to first-actions, pre-seat, because the kitchen-sink PRE-dated the hire — the D5 clock must run from kitchen-sink completion, not seat date. Caveats that cap conviction: N=5/4/8 per cohort; D1/D2 scored with hindsight risk (Joly's D2 was contemporaneously 'existential'; Su and Nadella are D1-fail monsters the screen structurally misses); instance selection tilts to famous cases (survivorship-adjacent); several windows capped at 13-23 months; two C2 wins carry exogenous confounds. Net: proceed to courts with the D1>=hard-gate / D2=hard-gate / D4=entry-modifier / D5=sink-clock formulation, and size for the fact that even the good cohort delivers ~60-80% hit rates, not certainty.
